name: Floor-Be-Gone
disable: DC 27 Crafting check (expert) to reinforce the stones of this causeway or DC 29 Thievery check (master) to jam the hinges on the boards

items.name: Oops, There It Goes!
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves through a marked square and fails a secret DC 5 Flat check

---
Effect The board's hinges release, causing the paving stones to drop—along with any creatures in the marked area—to the ground below. Affected creatures can attempt to grab-an-edge (DC 29). Creatures that fall take 4d12+26 bludgeoning damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save save) as well as the typical falling damage.

text: Hinged boards prop the massive paving stones into place on the causeway.
